g.text: Two separate datasets: archived-checkpoint development and fresh native confirmation
A: failures remain misses; automated teacher match is not an exhaustive constraint audit. Previously observed inputs are development evidence.
B: all failures retained, including one GoalSpec lexical verifier false negative; bars show family-bootstrap 95% intervals (4 families).
C: all observed trials retained, including startup waiting assigned unevenly across arms. Separate dataset from A; no cross-dataset causal claim.
